correctness.summary: Replacing the unit local-time threshold in Larsen's stopped Lyapunov proof by an arbitrary level a gives the d^(1-2beta)/a error term. DDS and the exponential Brownian local time at exit yield the local collision bound; the inverse-local-time tail yields the time estimate. For the global result, the nonnegative gap local martingale converges. A positive limiting gap would force infinite gap quadratic variation by recurrent midpoint occupation, contradicting local-martingale convergence; a zero limiting gap plus recurrent midpoint returns and the strong Markov property repeatedly exposes the high-probability local collision mechanism, forcing eventual collision almost surely.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Larsen (2026) proves positive-probability finite collision for small symmetric gaps but does not state probability tending to one, the collision-time scale, or almost-sure coalescence for every fixed pair. Barlow et al. (2001) prove almost-sure synchronous coalescence for skew Brownian motion and are treated as prior art for the general phenomenon. Searches for equivalent cusp-diffusion, synchronous-coalescence, non-confluence, and source-paper formulations found no prior statement of the claims here. Full texts of Yamada (1986) and Ouknine-Rutkowski (1990) were not directly inspected, so they remain residual originality risks.

value.summary: The result changes the interpretation of the subcritical cusp counterexample: collision is asymptotically certain at small gap and, for any fixed pair, eventually certain globally. The tunable local-time threshold also provides a quantitative upper collision scale that is absent from the source theorem.

limitations: No matching lower collision-time scale or limiting law.
Almost-sure coalescence is pairwise for fixed deterministic starts; no uncountable simultaneous-flow assertion.
The full Yamada (1986) and Ouknine-Rutkowski (1990) articles were not directly inspected.
Claims are tied to the coefficient families and estimates in arXiv:2609.19389v1.
Independent audit has not been performed.
